proposed_comments.title: Include Win (Both) in the Win modifier filter
proposed_comments.body:
Generic "Win (Both)" remaps are stored with Keyboard Manager's synthetic `VK_WIN_BOTH` value (`0x104`), but the Win filter currently checks only left and right Win. Those mappings disappear whenever users enable the Win modifier filter, so include the synthetic code in the Win family.

**Severity:** `medium`

```suggestion
        private static readonly int[] _winVkCodes = { 0x5B, 0x5C, 0x104 };
```

confidence.rationale: Keyboard Manager's validation and native helper code both treat 0x104 as VK_WIN_BOTH, and the current filter array contains only 0x5B/0x5C.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve app-filter selection using real app entries only

confidence.rationale: The first two combo entries are localized sentinels, while app names come from user configuration and are collected in a case-insensitive SortedSet.

proposed_comments.title: Clear bulk selection before disabling selection mode

confidence.rationale: The code comment and existing toggle path already establish that SelectedItems must be touched before SelectionMode becomes None, but the bulk-delete path skipped that ordering.

proposed_comments.title: Use singular bulk-delete resources when exactly one row is selected
proposed_comments.body:
### Use singular bulk-delete resources when exactly one row is selected

**Severity:** `low`

The button and confirmation text currently produce grammatically incorrect copy such as "Delete selected (1)" followed by "delete 1 remappings." Add singular resources for the one-item case and branch in `DeleteSelectedLabel` / `DeleteSelectedBtn_Click` so plural formatting is used only for counts other than one.

confidence.rationale: The current resource strings are unconditionally plural and the selected count is already available in both call sites.

proposed_comments.title: Prevent row-level actions from mutating data while bulk selection is active
proposed_comments.body:
### Prevent row-level actions from mutating data while bulk selection is active

**Severity:** `medium`

`IsItemClickEnabled` suppresses row editing in selection mode, but the per-row toggle switch and ellipsis menu can still fire. If one of those actions rebuilds the filtered lists while bulk selection is active, selected rows are cleared while the UI still appears to be in selection mode; deleting the last visible row can also hide the toolbar that contains Cancel. Either disable/hide those row actions while `IsSelectionMode` is true, or explicitly exit selection mode before handling an individual row delete/toggle.

confidence.rationale: The row action controls remain enabled inside each DataTemplate and their handlers mutate mapping state/reload views independently of the new selection-mode state.

proposed_comments.title: Give the new search and app filters stable accessible names
proposed_comments.body:
### Give the new search and app filters stable accessible names

**Severity:** `medium`

The search box currently relies on placeholder text as its only label, which disappears once users type. The app-filter combo also exposes values such as an app name without a stable control name, so screen-reader and voice-control users cannot reliably identify what the control does. Add localized `AutomationProperties.Name` resources for the search box and app combo, and give the combo an `x:Uid` so those resources apply.

confidence.rationale: The current XAML adds both controls in the PR; SearchBox has only PlaceholderText and AppFilterCombo has no x:Uid or accessible-name resource.

review.body_prefix: Thanks for getting this rebased and for adding the demo. The process side is unblocked, but I found a few current-head correctness and accessibility issues in the new Keyboard Manager editor filtering/bulk-delete flow that should be addressed before merge.
review.body:
### Keyboard Manager filter and selection fixes

**Severity:** `high`

Please address the current-head issues below before merge:

1. Include Keyboard Manager's synthetic `VK_WIN_BOTH` value (`0x104`) in the Win modifier filter so generic "Win (Both)" mappings are not hidden when the Win filter is active.
2. Restore the app-filter selection by searching only real app entries and comparing case-insensitively, so localized sentinel labels and app-name casing cannot select the wrong option.
3. Clear selected rows before changing the bound lists back to `SelectionMode.None` after bulk delete; `SelectedItems` is only safe while the lists are still in multi-select mode.
4. Prevent per-row toggle/menu actions from mutating mappings while bulk-selection mode is active, or explicitly exit selection mode before handling those individual row actions.
5. Add singular bulk-delete strings for the one-row case and add localized stable accessible names for the search box and app-filter combo.
